Hummus is incredibly easy to make in a blender.

  • 1/4 cup Tahini sauce (toasted sesame seeds blended with oil to make a paste, I am lazy & just keep sesame seeds around, toss 1/4 cup of sesame seeds in the blender with a bit of oil, then add the rest of the ingredients for the humus)
  • 1 can chick peas
  • 1 large lemon (juiced) (or 1/4 cup of lemon juice)
  • 1 clove of garlic (toss in skinned & whole)
  • 2 table spoons Olive Oil
  • 1/2 teaspoon of cumin
  • 2-3 tablespoons of water (I use the water from the can of chickpeas)
  • Salt to taste (try a 1/4 teaspoon to start)

Blend.

Plate up. Dash on some paprika & olive oil to make it look lovely.

The core components have a long shelf life, so just keep them handy. I have used vinegar (for the acid replacement of lemon juice) & jarred minced garlic in a pinch to avoid getting the fresh ingredients at the store.
